blind.description: A classic wingback armchair upholstered in dark forest-green tufted leather. It features a diamond-buttoned backrest, winged side supports, scrolled armrests with brass nailhead trim along the front edges, a thick removable seat cushion, and four turned dark wood legs with caster wheels. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with realistic materials and no floating or melted artifacts.
blind.from_above: Shows the square profile of the seat cushion bounded by two thick rounded armrests and the curved, button-tufted backrest with flared wings.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.3 ft tall (reaches waist height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 2.8 ft wide and deep.
